mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an economic perspective that focuses on an active state and its sovereignty."
Mercantilism is an economic perspective that focuses on an active state and its sovereignty.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a contemporary economic theory that explores the relevance of high national debt levels for independent economies producing their own currency."
Modern Monetary Theory (MMT) is a contemporary economic theory that explores the relevance of high national debt levels for independent economies producing their own currency.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a coherent and logical approach to understanding economic activity, focusing on four broad divisions: production, consumption, exchange, and distribution."
Marxian method of analysis is a coherent and logical approach to understanding economic activity, focusing on four broad divisions: production, consumption, exchange, and distribution.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a conglomeration or a collective vision of theories about how desirable change in society is best achieved."
Development theory is a conglomeration or a collective vision of theories about how desirable change in society is best achieved.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a theory that suggests economic variations, such as inflation rates, are primarily caused by changes in the money supply."
Monetarism is a theory that suggests economic variations, such as inflation rates, are primarily caused by changes in the money supply.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a useful rule to follow in imitating others because many evolutionary forces conspire to make adaptive behaviour common."
Conformity is a useful rule to follow in imitating others because many evolutionary forces conspire to make adaptive behaviour common.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a theory which uses ideas from different origins, such as ecology, sustainable development, feminism and welfare economics."
Human development theory is a theory which uses ideas from different origins, such as ecology, sustainable development, feminism and welfare economics.

Structuralism is a development theory that emphasizes the structural aspects that hinder economic growth in developing countries.

Externalization is an anthropological necessity, as humans cannot exist in a closed sphere of quiescent interiority.

The natural price is the lowest an entrepreneur will continue to sell at, while the actual price is the level at which a commodity is sold.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the application of mathematical methods to represent economic theories and analyze problems."
Mathematical economics is the application of mathematical methods to represent economic theories and analyze problems.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are considered to have distributive efficiency when goods are distributed to the people who can gain the most utility from them."
Situations are considered to have distributive efficiency when goods are distributed to the people who can gain the most utility from them.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a branch of economics that analyzes money as a medium of exchange, store of value, and unit of account."
Monetary economics is a branch of economics that analyzes money as a medium of exchange, store of value, and unit of account.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a practical science that fosters habits that expedite actions and helps individuals obtain and use necessary resources for living."
Economics is a practical science that fosters habits that expedite actions and helps individuals obtain and use necessary resources for living.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the freedom of general economic activity within a nation. ii."
Free enterprise is the freedom of general economic activity within a nation. ii.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a prominent example of how Schumpeterian growth is portrayed (Aghion and Howitt, 1992)."
The Aghion-Howitt model is a prominent example of how Schumpeterian growth is portrayed (Aghion and Howitt, 1992).

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a policy regime that encourages exports, discourages imports, controls capital movement, and centralizes currency decisions in the hands of a central government."
Neo-mercantilism is a policy regime that encourages exports, discourages imports, controls capital movement, and centralizes currency decisions in the hands of a central government.
